bullets.content: [general] Change exactly ONE factor between consecutive meshes (repeated failure gens 0-3, last time 4 changes instead of the promised box 0.0018). Write the exact mesh call for solve 1 in the first message and run it verbatim; compare(prev,new) to attribute.
[general] Never call compare(solve_a=k, solve_b=k) (noise 0.009) or repeat a compare (2 vs 1 twice wasted calls). Plan compares before the solves: after solve n, call compare(prev, n) once.

[general] Check the playbook energy ladder before solve 1: if the exact recipe already has recorded energy and DOFs, skip it. Deterministic mesher and solver mean an exact re-run gives identical numbers.
[general] Do not spend a solve on a one-step h change when the ladder is known flat; spend it on a structural change (ring refinement by group, wall band box).

[general] Use all 4 solves, every time. Anchor first (recorded run energy/DOFs counts as anchor), then one new factor per solve with compare(candidate, anchor). Never re-run a recorded mesh: g6 solve 1 reproduced 2.13420e-4 exactly and wasted 25% of budget.
[general] If you override your own written submit rule, first write the replacement rule with numbers and reason. Do not decide afterwards from interpolated scores (missed target by 0.17 points).

[general] Displacement FE underestimates strain energy: the HIGHER-energy mesh is closer to converged; never call lower energy 'better' (a1 submitted 0.03346 over 0.03401). Energy gap is not a field-error %. True error ~1.5x compare change to a finer solve.

[general] After EACH solve call view(kind=error) and compare(previous/anchor, new) before the next mesh (g6 compared only at the end). Read top-5 hotspot local h. Requested sizes are not achieved (0.003 gave 0.0036), so request about 0.75x the wanted size.
[general] When error is diffuse, score falls slowly with DOFs: accuracy beyond the target is not worth 5x DOFs. Submit the cheapest solve that still meets the target error.
[general] Call view(solve=<the one you submit>, kind=error) and read top-5 hotspot local h before submit; g4's submitted solve was never viewed.
[general] Do not submit for the diversity bonus if base drops: it pays +0.1 only when base >=90% of best. A 15.2% run at 30k would have scored higher base than the h 0.006 diversity run.
[general] Where a clamped face meets a loaded region, error concentrates (1-1.3 mm above f12). Refine a thin box hugging the clamp under the load, not the whole loaded face.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Solve ladder, h-only: 0.004, 0.0037 (finest, <49k nodes), 0.0042, then pick or 0.0043. Use all 4. Never re-solve h 0.0045 (0.033980 at 30.1k known); compare against it. Accept finer h only if relative error drop > DOF rise (0.0045->0.004 needs <~12.5% at 36.5k); write numbers first.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Score falls slowly with DOFs: automesher 6057 DOFs/31.9% vs a0 36435/15.4% gives error ~N^-0.4, base score ~N^-0.2. Your 22k run scored 0.224 vs a0's 36k at 0.172. Coarser h favoured unless the target can be crossed; aim ~12k DOFs.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] After EVERY solve: view(error), compare(N, finest), read local h at top-ring (f20, z~0.056) and junction (z~0.024) hotspots; also view the submitted solve.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Ladder: h 0.0052 gives 0.033712 at 26.5k (13.3% vs 0.0045); +f2 0.0027 r0.007: 0.033770 at 27.2k, 16.1% field, 7.2% check pts, just missed target. Need energy >=~0.03390 at 28-30k. Base 0.217 vs 0.211 flat; among near-equal, submit finer one safely under 15.9%.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] P1 (top ring z 0.057) -14.6% worst disclosed point; hidden worst (9.2%) near f23 z 0.0255. Refine top ring and wall band, not f2.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] a0's h 0.0045 with edge40/f2 0.003 r0.005 gave best base 0.202 at 31.6k (ring h 0.0037); RMS 3.6% at h 0.0034 with f2/edge39/edge8. Ring refinement by edge/group is cheaper than boxing the whole top.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] At h 0.006 f2 touching h was 0.0042 (a0 0.0037); top ring held 16.7% error, P1 -22%. Check f2 touching h <=0.0038 before solving. If h 0.0052 loses at ring, test f2 0.0026 r0.006.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Junction boxes z 0.017-0.036 are standard (z 0.020-0.033 lost 0.26%). Global h sizes the wall: at h 0.0052 f20 touching h 0.00402, f23 0.00397, P0 error +3.0%->+8.3%. Lower wall z 0.005-0.015 near f23 is at background h, so h 0.004 refines it.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] f2 0.0027 r0.007 (vs 0.003 r0.005) gave +5.8e-5 J for +232 nodes at h 0.0052, f2 touching h 0.00363: cheap top-ring lever for a later control.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Junction saddles z 0.022-0.031 beside f9/f10/f13/f19 (2.1-2.9% each, h 0.0036-0.0039, 14-19% error); 0.003 boxes deliver ~0.0036. Test request 0.0025 in boxes, or wall-only box z 0.022-0.031 at 0.0024 with global h 0.006.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Top ring z 0.052-0.058 (f3/f21) holds largest cells (3.7-3.9%, 150-280% local error) at h~0.0038. Try group f21 size 0.0028 r0.004 as single-factor test, not a box over f25 disc.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Plugs f15/f17 and branch far ends (f5, f6) are dark on error map; coarsen with global h 0.006-0.007 and recover the wall with a wall box to free DOFs.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Do not coarsen tube wall above ~0.005: wall box 0.0065 dropped SE 0.03354 to 0.03284, compare 16.8%, min quality 0.135. Diffuse wall error at h 0.0043 binds; a uniform 0.005 wall box also wasted DOFs.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Solve schedule: S1 best coarse-h candidate; S2 second-best h; S3 h 0.0045 (finer pole); S4 best plus one tweak. Never re-solve a3's h 0.007 (2.13415e-4, 17397 DOFs). Setup verified (3d, E 2.1e11, nu 0.3, f12 fixed, 2.1e6 on f7).

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Accuracy baseline: h 0.01, f7 0.0032 r0.008, f5 0.0038 r0.006, clamp box 0.002 r0.003: 8.0% at 22k DOFs (SE 2.1371e-4). Over-spent (cost 0.397); trim DOFs in the far block, not the band.

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Boxes must be thin, at clamp level (z < -0.004), size <= 0.0035. A broad box over the loaded side (size 0.0045) shifted error but did not lower it.

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Read min_quality after the h 0.016 mesh (0.002 band box = 8x jump). If <0.11, add f9 and f38 size 0.0035 r0.004 (quality 0.11->0.17, +243 DOFs). If still <0.1, use h 0.014.

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Binding error: band z -0.0068..-0.0076 above clamp f12, x 0.018-0.027 (hotspots #1-#4, ~37% energy; local h 0.0025-0.0028 with 0.002 box). To refine further use thinner box [0.017,-0.008,-0.0082,0.028,0.013,-0.0058] at 0.0016-0.0018.

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Band box 0.0028 vs 0.002: SE 2.1149e-4 vs 2.1307e-4, compare 8.8%, 17.5k vs 20.3k DOFs. Band needs requested size <=0.0022; do not coarsen it. Request ~0.75x target size since requested 0.002 gave local 0.0025-0.0028.

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Keep a3's top-arm box [0.015,0.012,-0.0082,0.03,0.026,-0.003] at 0.0035. Without it hotspots #5 (beside f2) and #6 (beside f4) held ~8% and check-point RMS was 6.67% vs 5.8%.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Copy a3's DOF cut: drop f5 0.0038 r0.006, f7 r0.008->0.005, add arm box [0.012,-0.022,-0.0035,0.03,0.022,0.0082] at 0.0042. Saved 2k DOFs at equal field error (8.59 vs 8.51%), check RMS 5.25%.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Node count jumps by mesher regime, not h: 6.2-6.5k vs 7.3-8.7k nodes on same recipe (h 0.0055:7305, 0.0065:6468, 0.0075:7600). Free-mesh and reject >7000-node meshes before solving.
[abc_00000065_bc0] Quality guard: a3 recipe at h 0.011 gave q 0.1104 (legal). If any ladder mesh has q<0.105, step to next h (0.0106) rather than adding refinements.
[abc_00000065_bc0] Zero-DOF tweaks are noise (f38 radius 0.004->0.008: compare 3.9%, -3 DOFs). Target clamp slab hotspots (41% energy, local h 0.0025-0.0027) or DOF sinks (f12 1092, f5 788, f13 766).

[abc_00000065_bc0] Later tests: hotspot #5 (4.1%, h 0.0039, +y end near f4): extend slab box y-max to 0.017 at 0.002 r0.003 (<500 DOFs est). f39 (+x,+y, z~-0.002, spread 6.3%): {f39 0.0035 r0.003}, accept if <300 nodes.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Thinner band box [0.017,-0.008,-0.0082,0.028,0.013,-0.0058] at 0.0016 r0.002 with h 0.008 to offset DOFs (band holds ~40% error energy). Also f9 0.003 r0.005 for P2 (0.0217,-0.0209,0), -18% worst disclosed point.

[abc_00000065_bc0] If top-arm box is dropped, hotspot #5 (beside f4, h 0.0039) and y 0.0144 cell (24%) are under-refined: restore box [0.015,0.012,-0.0082,0.03,0.026,-0.003] at 0.0035 or add f4 0.003 r0.004.

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Later single-factor test: f5 has hotspots #4/#5 near x 0.019 at coarse h (0.0065). If the box doesn't cover them, add {group: f5, size 0.004, radius 0.004}. Also consider f12 junction (hotspot #1, 16%) at size 0.003 r0.006.

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Far arm (y≈-0.037, f52/f13) is contested but low stress (1.2-2.6e5 Pa). At h 0.016, if compare shows >15% share there, add f52 0.008 r0.005 rather than lowering h. Worst hidden point (13.7%) near f13 (h 0.0049): test f13 0.0035 r0.004.
[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Idea: try f12 size 0.003 r0.004 instead of the dense clamp box to keep band resolution at fewer DOFs (single-factor test).
